title: India's Digital Divide — Map 2: City vs Village
credit: Data: NFHS-6 · Boundaries: Government of India

beats.say: But the real divide isn't between states. It's between the city and the village.
Nationally, seventy-seven percent of urban women are online — but only fifty-nine percent of rural. An eighteen point penalty.
This map shows that gap, state by state. Brighter means a bigger rural penalty.

stops.say: Some states closed it. Goa — a gap of just three points.
Kerala, four. Village women nearly caught up.
Punjab, six. Delhi's villages even pass its city.
Others didn't. Gujarat — a twenty-seven point gap.
Karnataka, twenty-nine. Three quarters of city women, under half of rural.

beats.say: Same country, opposite outcomes. That's the divide nobody draws.
